name: Creamy Pesto Chicken and Pepper Skillet

fit.note: Published 425 cal / 15g carb clears both axes with headroom; no rice/pasta/potato base; weigh-and-divide scalable; budget skillet dinner. FIT.

evidence: Near-duplicate of the ACCEPTED creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet: both are boneless chicken-breast skillet sautés in a heavy-cream pan sauce built on sun-dried tomatoes with no starch base (4/4 on protein/method/starch/creamy-sun-dried-tomato sauce family). The only divergence is added pesto and bell-peppers+onion in place of spinach - a hero-flavor/vegetable shift, not a different dinner. Sitting next to 'Creamy Tuscan Chicken Skillet' in an already Italian-American-heavy catalog, two creamy sun-dried-tomato chicken-breast skillets read as the same plate. Pesto is a genuine basil-forward distinguisher, so this is flagged borderline rather than a hard kill, but I lean DUPE.
catalog_check: Only pesto recipe in the 544-recipe catalog digest is turkey-pesto-pasta-kale (turkey + pesto + rotini pasta) - a different protein and a pasta dish, NOT a collision. No creamy-tuscan/marry-me/pesto chicken skillet exists in the live catalog; the collision is entirely with this run's accepted/pool set.

pool_collisions.relation: Shares the pesto + chicken-breast + skillet + Italian hero. Distinguished by sauce: mine is a heavy-cream sauce with sun-dried tomatoes + bell peppers; theirs is oil-based jarred pesto with cherry tomato + zucchini + a fresh-mozzarella melt (no cream, no sun-dried tomato). Moderate collision - the two pesto chicken skillets should not both ship.
pool_collisions.note_for_decider: If the decider keeps a pesto chicken skillet, pick ONE of {this, pesto-mozzarella-chicken-skillet}. pesto-mozzarella is the cleaner 'pesto chicken' (5g carb, 44g protein, no cream-vs-tuscan overlap); this candidate collides harder with the accepted tuscan skillet.

pool_collisions.relation: Also a creamy sun-dried-tomato Parmesan chicken-breast skillet (half-and-half + sun-dried tomato + parmesan, no pesto, no peppers). Three-way creamy-sun-dried-tomato-chicken-skillet cluster with this candidate and the accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet - the catalog wants at most one or two of these, not all three.

cross_protein_twins: A pesto/creamy chicken breast skillet has an obvious turkey twin (turkey cutlets in pesto cream) - and turkey-pesto-pasta-kale already lives in the catalog (turkey+pesto, pasta form). Also a pork twin: creamy-tuscan-pork-chops has a verdict in this run and is the same sauce family on pork. Decider should check the pesto-cream sauce family across turkey/pork selectors.
ground-beef-zucchini-pesto-skillet and pesto-beef-zucchini-skillet in the pool are the beef pesto twins (different base - zucchini, not cream).
confidence: high on FIT and ingredient profile (read from candidate + source); moderate on the borderline call - reasonable adjudicators could rule this a hard DUPE of creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet or a KEEP on the pesto distinguisher, which is why it is flagged for the decider.
